video.title: Would You Like One? 🤖🦆
video.description:
That's not a toy duck. 😳 Meet the Micro Duck, a 10-inch AI robot that walks, grabs things with its beak... and even rides a skateboard.

When it falls, it gets back up on its own using self-learning AI. And the craziest part? You can program tricks straight from your phone 🦆📱

In its first 24 hours, it pulled in over $2.5 million in sales — from a little tiltable desk toy to a viral robot celebrity.

Hold on... who'd have thought a cute, harmless-looking duck would become the internet's next robot star 🎬

#MicroDuck #robot #AIrobot #humanoidrobot #cuterobot #robotsofinstagram #futuretech #technews #viralrobot #robotfuture
